readback.method: Recomputed from saved global coordinate, normal, gradient, and ds rows using plain Python math.fsum; no integrator, field provider, or solver import

source_findings.finding: Inputs are copied to float64 before MAX_SAMPLES is enforced; np.asarray can also allocate for list-like values.
source_findings.acceptance: Check each row/byte count and shared sample count before any conversion/copy; reject 257 rows before an allocation/copy hook runs.

source_findings.finding: One scalar upper/lower trace label cannot distinguish a batch containing exact branch-face samples from both crack lips.
source_findings.acceptance: Keep exact branch samples UNKNOWN, or use and test a per-row side label before supporting exact cut samples.

passes: Mode III integrand and global-frame component conventions on the supplied exact field samples
finite planar geometry, outward orientation, closure, winding, and no exact front/branch quadrature sample
declared contour quadrature tolerance and monotonic order improvement

front_step_acceptance.commit_requirement: reanalyze candidate geometry, mechanics, and energy balance
front_step_acceptance.unknown_inputs: must remain UNKNOWN; no fabricated growth, branching, or passed energy check

passes: G below Gc arrests; equality does not propose; G above Gc produces only a pending geometry candidate
proposal leaves the prior active surface unchanged
confirmation requires a candidate-bound reanalyzed surface and geometry/state hashes plus reviewed energy receipt fields
missing energy evidence retains the old active version
the only saved successful transition is COMMITTED_FIXTURE_ONLY / EXPLICIT_FIXTURE_NOT_SOLVER and remains NOT_COUPLED
no turning, branching, or front splitting is represented
limitations: Hashes, solver/status labels, and REVIEWED receipts are caller declarations; this source has no authenticity verifier or mechanics solver.
Energy closure residual is recorded without a tolerance or pass/fail criterion; no energy-balance validation is established.
All states remain NOT_COUPLED / EXPERIMENTAL_UNCALIBRATED; no real physical front advance is qualified.
Only a finite straight +x front is supported; turning and branching remain unsupported.
front_step_review.review_scope: Static review and hash readback only; no front-step tests were rerun.
